product: Download the retained career event history currently displayed in LogPanel.
inputs: Only the immutable-by-convention current history prop; no backend call or summary/session inference.

formats.json: uma-sim-retained-log/1; scope=displayed-retained-history; exact entries and entry count
formats.text: UTF-8 readable report with retained-history caveat and one numbered block per entry

selection: Always every current retained entry, independent of search text and following mode.
capture: Synchronous serialization in the click handler, before the browser download request.
effects: One local Blob download request per explicit click; object URL cleanup; no server, simulation, persistence or selection effects.
empty: Disable the UI action when no entries are retained; serializer can represent an empty sequence.
failure: Synchronous preparation/request exceptions become an inline error; no automatic retry or saved-success assertion.
ownership: No App, RacePanel, logView, native API/engine, runStore, session, library, dependency or workflow edits. Preserve PR80 authorship and current #86 RacePanel owner.
runtime_limit: Native Node/React/Blob and build qualification here; no available local Chromium executable. A separate browser carrier will retain actual download checks without claiming execution.
